metadataRaw.title: Sciatica Pain Relief in Seconds #Shorts
metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe shows a simple exercise that can offer instant sciatica leg pain relief.

It is a blend of two popular sciatica exercises: sciatic nerve flossing and the figure 4. The combination of these two can help quickly take tension off the nerve and the muscles associated with sciatica pain (including the piriformis). 

It can be done at home, requires no equipment, and can give sciatica pain relief in seconds.

Let us know how it works for you!
